### User

توی فرمولاسیون میخوام که درصد ها رو به کار بر نشون نده و اعداد عشاری مقدار هم به صورت چهار عدد اعشاری نشون بده

---

### DeepSeek AI

<span>  th {</span>

<span></span>
<span>  .toc {</span>

<span>  }</span>
<span>  .toc h2 { border: none; margin-top: 0; color: #d35400; }</span>

<span>  .toc a { color: #2c3e50; text-decoration: none; }</span>

<span>  .simple-box {</span>

<span>    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;</span>
<span>  }</span>
<span></span>
<span>  .warning-box {</span>
<span>    background: #fff3cd;</span>
<span>    border-right: 4px solid #f39c12;</span>

<span>    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;</span>

<span></span>
<span>  .danger-box {</span>
<span>    background: #f8d7da;</span>

<span></span>

<span></span>
<span>-- ========== Materials ==========</span>
<span>IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Materials)</span>
<span>BEGIN</span>
<span>    INSERT INTO Materials (Code, DisplayName, IsActive, CreatedAt, IsDeleted) VALUES</span>
<span>    (N'Aca', N'Acetic Acid', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Dgl', N'Dry Gelatin', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Gso', N'Glycerin', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Mpa', N'Methyl Paraben', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Pgc', N'Propylene Glycol', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Ppa', N'Propyl Paraben', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Sdo', N'Silicon Dioxide', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Sls', N'Sodium Lauryl Sulfate', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Zns', N'Zinc Sulfate', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0),</span>
<span>    (N'Tio', N'Titanium Dioxide', 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0);</span>
<span>END</span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span>-- ========== Product Formulas ==========</span>
<span>DELETE FROM ProductFormulas;</span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span>DECLARE @Y000_CCode NVARCHAR(20) = N'Y000';</span>
<span>DECLARE @W000_CCode NVARCHAR(20) = N'W000';</span>
<span></span>
<span>-- Y000 (زرد کهربایی)</span>
<span>INSERT INTO ProductFormulas (CCode, MaterialId, Percentage, SortOrder, CreatedAt, IsDeleted)</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.344000012, 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Aca'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 100.0, 2, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Dgl'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.574000001, 3, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Mpa'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.953400016, 4, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Pgc'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.066, 5, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Ppa'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.1384615, 6, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Sdo'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.1875, 7, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Sls'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @Y000_CCode, Id, 0.256000012, 8, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Zns';</span>
<span></span>
<span>-- W000 (پیست)</span>
<span>INSERT INTO ProductFormulas (CCode, MaterialId, Percentage, SortOrder, CreatedAt, IsDeleted)</span>
<span>SELECT @W000_CCode, Id, 27.2154007, 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Dgl'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @W000_CCode, Id, 81.50700378, 2, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Gso'</span>
<span>UNION ALL</span>
<span>SELECT @W000_CCode, Id, 81.50700378, 3, GETUTCDATE(), 0 FROM Materials WHERE Code = N'Tio';</span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span>-- بررسی</span>
<span>SELECT pf.CCode, m.Code AS MaterialCode, pf.Percentage</span>
<span>FROM ProductFormulas pf</span>
<span>JOIN Materials m ON pf.MaterialId = m.Id</span>
<span>ORDER BY pf.CCode, pf.SortOrder;</span>
<span>GO<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span>DECLARE @MeltingModuleId INT = (SELECT Id FROM Modules WHERE Code = 'Melting');</span>
<span></span>
<span>IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Forms WHERE Code = 'ReleasePermission')</span>
<span>BEGIN</span>
<span>    INSERT INTO Forms (ModuleId, Code, DisplayName, ControllerName, ShowInMenu, SupportsDataScope, SortOrder, IsActive, CreatedAt, IsDeleted)</span>
<span>    VALUES (@MeltingModuleId, N'ReleasePermission', N'صدور مجوز ساخت', N'ReleasePermission', 1, 0, 2, 1, GETUTCDATE(), 0);</span>
<span>END</span>
<span>GO</span>
<span></span>
<span>DECLARE @AdminRoleId INT = (SELECT Id FROM Roles WHERE Name = 'Administrator');</span>
<span>DECLARE @ReleaseFormId INT = (SELECT Id FROM Forms WHERE Code = 'ReleasePermission');</span>
<span></span>
<span>INSERT INTO RoleFormPermissions (RoleId, FormId, PermissionId)</span>
<span>SELECT @AdminRoleId, @ReleaseFormId, Id</span>
<span>FROM Permissions</span>
<span>WHERE NOT EXISTS (</span>
<span>    SELECT 1 FROM RoleFormPermissions rfp</span>
<span>    WHERE rfp.RoleId = @AdminRoleId </span>
<span>      AND rfp.FormId = @ReleaseFormId</span>
<span>      AND rfp.PermissionId = Permissions.Id</span>
<span>);</span>
<span>GO<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>public class CalculationResult</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public decimal C0 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal C1 { get; set; }</span>

<span>    public decimal Wei0 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal EqcCapsule { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal WtrNeed { get; set; }</span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Melting.DTOs;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Melting.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>/// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>/// محاسبات مجوز ساخت - عیناً از VBA اکسس</span>
<span>/// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>public static class ReleasePermissionCalculator</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private const double SLOPE = 0.08152;</span>
<span>    private const double INTERCEPT = 0.437019;</span>
<span>    private const double DENSITY = 1.096;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public static CalculationResult Calculate(</span>
<span>        string part,        // "melt" / "pst"</span>
<span>        decimal vol0,</span>
<span>        decimal vis0,</span>
<span>        decimal vis1,</span>
<span>        int lagTime)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var result = new CalculationResult();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 1) ویسکوزیته نهایی موثر ======</span>
<span>        // vis1m = vis1 + (lagtime * 5)</span>
<span>        var vis1m = vis1 + (lagTime * 5);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 2) غلظت اولیه ======</span>
<span>        // c0 = Int((((0.4342945 * Log(vis0)) - intercept) / slope) * 100 + 0.5) / 100</span>
<span>        var c0Raw = ((0.4342945 * Math.Log((double)vis0)) - INTERCEPT) / SLOPE;</span>
<span>        var c0 = Math.Floor(c0Raw * 100 + 0.5) / 100;</span>
<span>        result.C0 = (decimal)c0;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 3) غلظت نهایی ======</span>
<span>        var c1Raw = ((0.4342945 * Math.Log((double)vis1m)) - INTERCEPT) / SLOPE;</span>
<span>        var c1 = Math.Floor(c1Raw * 100 + 0.5) / 100;</span>
<span>        result.C1 = (decimal)c1;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 4) حجم نهایی ======</span>
<span>        // vol1 = c0 * vol0 / c1</span>
<span>        var vol1 = c0 * (double)vol0 / c1;</span>
<span>        result.Vol1 = (decimal)vol1;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 5) وزن اولیه ======</span>
<span>        // wei0 = vol0 * 1.096 * 1000</span>
<span>        var wei0 = (double)vol0 * DENSITY * 1000;</span>
<span>        result.Wei0 = (decimal)wei0;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // ====== 6) محاسبات مخصوص هر محصول ======</span>
<span>        if (part == "melt")</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            // eqccapsule = Int((c0 / 100 * wei0) + 0.5)</span>
<span>            var eqc = Math.Floor((c0 / 100 * wei0) + 0.5);</span>
<span>            result.EqcCapsule = (decimal)eqc;</span>
<span></span>
<span>            // wtrneed = Int((vol0 * 1.096) - (eqccapsule / 1000))</span>
<span>            var wtr = Math.Floor(((double)vol0 * DENSITY) - (eqc / 1000));</span>
<span>            result.WtrNeed = (decimal)wtr;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        else if (part == "pst")</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            // eqccapsule = Int(((vol0 * 1.096 * c0 / 100 * (20 / 100) + (vol0 * (20 / 100)))) * 1000 + 0.5)</span>
<span>            var eqcRaw = ((double)vol0 * DENSITY * c0 / 100 * (20.0 / 100))</span>
<span>                       + ((double)vol0 * (20.0 / 100));</span>
<span>            var eqc = Math.Floor(eqcRaw * 1000 + 0.5);</span>
<span>            result.EqcCapsule = (decimal)eqc;</span>
<span></span>
<span>            // wtrneed = Int(((vol0 * 1.096 * (60 / 100))) * 1000 + 0.5)</span>
<span>            var wtrRaw = ((double)vol0 * DENSITY * (60.0 / 100)) * 1000;</span>
<span>            var wtr = Math.Floor(wtrRaw + 0.5);</span>
<span>            result.WtrNeed = (decimal)wtr;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return result;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>

<span></span>

<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public interface IReleasePermissionService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    /// گرفتن شماره سریال بعدی برای یک CCode</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetNextSerialAsync(string cCode, CancellationToken ct = default);</span>
<span></span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    /// گرفتن فرمول مواد برای یک CCode</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ProductFormulaDto<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetFormulaAsync(string cCode, CancellationToken ct = default);</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class ProductFormulaDto</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public string MaterialCode { get; set; } = null!;</span>
<span>    public string MaterialDisplayName { get; set; } = null!;</span>
<span>    public decimal Percentage { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public int SortOrder { get; set; }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>div</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>code-header<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - ReleasePermissionService.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token special-attr"><span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span><span class="token value javascript language-javascript"><span class="token function">copyCode</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">this</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span></span><span class="token punctuation">"</span></span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Services;</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class ReleasePermissionService : IReleasePermissionService</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public ReleasePermissionService(ApplicationDbContext db)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>int<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetNextSerialAsync(string cCode, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // MAX(serial) + 1 برای همون CCode (Y000 یا W000)</span>
<span>        var maxSerial = await _db.ReleasePermissions</span>
<span>            .Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.CCode == cCode)</span>
<span>            .Select(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> (int?)x.Serial)</span>
<span>            .MaxAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return (maxSerial ?? 0) + 1;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ProductFormulaDto<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetFormulaAsync(string cCode, CancellationToken ct = default)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        return await _db.ProductFormulas</span>
<span>            .Where(pf =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> pf.CCode == cCode)</span>
<span>            .OrderBy(pf =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> pf.SortOrder)</span>
<span>            .Select(pf =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new ProductFormulaDto</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                MaterialCode = pf.Material.Code,</span>
<span>                MaterialDisplayName = pf.Material.DisplayName,</span>
<span>                Percentage = pf.Percentage,</span>
<span>                SortOrder = pf.SortOrder</span>
<span>            })</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "تاریخ الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [RegularExpression(@"^\d{4}/\d{2}/\d{2}$", ErrorMessage = "فرمت تاریخ صحیح نیست")]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "تاریخ")]</span>

<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "شیفت الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "شیفت")]</span>
<span>    public string Shift { get; set; } = "صبح";</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "نوع تولید الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "نوع تولید")]</span>
<span>    public string CCode { get; set; } = "Y000";  // Y000 یا W000</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "شماره دستگاه الزامی است")]</span>

<span>    [Display(Name = "شماره دستگاه")]</span>
<span>    public int Machine { get; set; } = 0;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== ورودی‌های محاسباتی ==========</span>
<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "حجم اولیه الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [Range(0.1, 2000, ErrorMessage = "حجم اولیه باید بین 0.1 تا 2000 لیتر باشد")]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "حجم اولیه (لیتر)")]</span>
<span>    public decimal Vol0 { get; set; } = 943.15M;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "ویسکوزیته اولیه الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [Range(1, 10000)]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "ویسکوزیته اولیه")]</span>
<span>    public decimal Vis0 { get; set; } = 1000M;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Required(ErrorMessage = "ویسکوزیته نهایی الزامی است")]</span>
<span>    [Range(1, 10000)]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "ویسکوزیته نهایی")]</span>
<span>    public decimal Vis1 { get; set; } = 1000M;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Range(0, 500)]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "مدت حباب‌گیری (دقیقه)")]</span>
<span>    public int LagTime { get; set; } = 0;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== اطلاعات محصول ==========</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "نام محصول")]</span>
<span>    public string? ProductName { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "کمپانی")]</span>
<span>    public string? Company { get; set; } = "IGCC";</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "کد رنگ")]</span>
<span>    public string? ColorCode { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "شماره تانک")]</span>
<span>    public string? TankNo { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [StringLength(2000)]</span>
<span>    [Display(Name = "توضیحات")]</span>
<span>    public string? Notes { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== محاسبات (فقط خواندنی) ==========</span>

<span>    public decimal? C1 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal? Vol1 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal? Wei0 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal? EqcCapsule { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal? WtrNeed { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== خودکار تولید شده ==========</span>
<span>    public string? FeedRecNo { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public string? BatchNo { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public int? Serial { get; set; }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== فرمول مواد ==========</span>
<span>    public List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>FormulaRowViewModel<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> FormulaRows { get; set; } = new();</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ========== Dropdown Options ==========</span>
<span>    public List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>CCodeOption<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> CCodeOptions =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new()</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        new("Y000", "زرد کهربایی (Y000)"),</span>
<span>        new("W000", "پیست سفید (W000)")</span>
<span>    };</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public List<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>string<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> ShiftOptions =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new() { "صبح", "شب" };</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>

<span>{</span>
<span>    public string MaterialCode { get; set; } = null!;</span>
<span>    public string MaterialDisplayName { get; set; } = null!;</span>
<span>    public decimal Percentage { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal RequiredGr { get; set; }  // محاسبه شده</span>
<span>    public int SortOrder { get; set; }</span>
<span>}</span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>button</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>copy-btn<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token special-attr"><span class="token attr-name">onclick</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span><span class="token value javascript language-javascript"><span class="token function">copyCode</span><span class="token punctuation">(</span><span class="token keyword">this</span><span class="token punctuation">)</span></span><span class="token punctuation">"</span></span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>📋 کپی<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>button</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Melting.Services;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers.Api;</span>
<span></span>
<span>[Authorize]</span>
<span>[Route("api/release-permission")]</span>
<span>[ApiController]</span>
<span>public class ReleasePermissionApiController : ControllerBase</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly IReleasePermissionService _service;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public ReleasePermissionApiController(IReleasePermissionService service)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _service = service;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    /// محاسبه‌ی فرمول‌ها + گرفتن فرمول مواد + serial بعدی</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    [HttpPost("calculate")]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Calculate(</span>
<span>        [FromBody] CalculateRequest request,</span>
<span>        CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // 1) محاسبات</span>
<span>        var result = ReleasePermissionCalculator.Calculate(</span>
<span>            request.Part, request.Vol0, request.Vis0, request.Vis1, request.LagTime);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) سریال بعدی</span>
<span>        var serial = await _service.GetNextSerialAsync(request.CCode, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) فرمول مواد</span>
<span>        var formula = await _service.GetFormulaAsync(request.CCode, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 4) محاسبه‌ی مقدار گرم هر ماده</span>
<span>        var materials = formula.Select(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            f.MaterialCode,</span>
<span>            f.MaterialDisplayName,</span>
<span>            f.Percentage,</span>
<span>            RequiredGr = Math.Round((decimal)f.Percentage / 100 * result.EqcCapsule, 4),</span>
<span>            f.SortOrder</span>
<span>        }).ToList();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 5) FeedRecNo + BatchNo</span>
<span>        var year = request.Farsidate.Replace("/", "").Substring(0, 4);</span>
<span>        var machineStr = request.Machine.ToString("D2");</span>
<span>        var partCode = request.Part == "melt" ? "3" : "4";</span>
<span>        var serialStr = serial.ToString("D4");</span>
<span>        var feedRecNo = $"{year}{machineStr}{partCode}{serialStr}";</span>
<span>        var batchPrefix = request.Part == "melt" ? "melt" : "pst";</span>
<span>        var batchNo = $"{batchPrefix}{serial}";</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return Ok(new</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            c0 = result.C0,</span>
<span>            c1 = result.C1,</span>
<span>            vol1 = result.Vol1,</span>
<span>            wei0 = result.Wei0,</span>
<span>            eqcCapsule = result.EqcCapsule,</span>
<span>            wtrNeed = result.WtrNeed,</span>
<span>            serial,</span>
<span>            feedRecNo,</span>
<span>            batchNo,</span>
<span>            materials</span>
<span>        });</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    /// گرفتن فرمول مواد برای یک CCode</span>
<span>    /// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    [HttpGet("formula/{cCode}")]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> GetFormula(string cCode, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var formula = await _service.GetFormulaAsync(cCode, ct);</span>
<span>        return Ok(formula);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class CalculateRequest</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public string Part { get; set; } = "melt";</span>
<span>    public string CCode { get; set; } = "Y000";</span>
<span>    public string Farsidate { get; set; } = "1405/07/08";</span>
<span>    public int Machine { get; set; } = 0;</span>
<span>    public decimal Vol0 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal Vis0 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public decimal Vis1 { get; set; }</span>
<span>    public int LagTime { get; set; }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>h1</span> <span class="token attr-name">id</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>controller<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>۱۱. ReleasePermissionController<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>h1</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.DataScopes.Extensions;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Features.Melting.Services;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Domain.Entities.Melting;</span>

<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Controllers;</span>
<span></span>
<span>[HasPermission("ReleasePermission", "View")]</span>
<span>public class ReleasePermissionController : Controller</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;</span>
<span>    private readonly IDataScopeService _dataScope;</span>
<span>    private readonly ICurrentUserService _currentUser;</span>
<span>    private readonly IReleasePermissionService _service;</span>
<span></span>
<span>    public ReleasePermissionController(</span>
<span>        ApplicationDbContext db,</span>
<span>        IDataScopeService dataScope,</span>
<span>        ICurrentUserService currentUser,</span>
<span>        IReleasePermissionService service)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        _db = db;</span>
<span>        _dataScope = dataScope;</span>
<span>        _currentUser = currentUser;</span>
<span>        _service = service;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    // لیست</span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Index(string? search, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var scope = await _dataScope.GetCurrentScopeAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var query = _db.ReleasePermissions</span>
<span>            .ApplyDataScope(scope)</span>
<span>            .AsQueryable();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            query = query.Where(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                x.FeedRecNo.Contains(search) ||</span>
<span>                x.BatchNo.Contains(search) ||</span>
<span>                x.Farsidate.Contains(search));</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var items = await query</span>
<span>            .OrderByDescending(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Id)</span>
<span>            .Take(200)</span>
<span>            .ToListAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        ViewBag.Search = search;</span>
<span>        return View(items);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    // جزئیات</span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Details(int id, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var item = await _db.ReleasePermissions</span>
<span>            .Include(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Materials)</span>
<span>            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.Id == id, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (item == null) return NotFound();</span>
<span>        return View(item);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    // ساخت جدید</span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    [HasPermission("ReleasePermission", "Create")]</span>
<span>    [HttpGet]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Create(CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var vm = new ReleasePermissionViewModel</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            Farsidate = PersianDateHelper.ToPersianDateString(DateTime.Now),</span>
<span>            Shift = "صبح",</span>
<span>            CCode = "Y000",</span>
<span>            Vol0 = 943.15M,</span>
<span>            Vis0 = 1000M,</span>
<span>            Vis1 = 1000M,</span>
<span>            LagTime = 0</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        await PopulateCalculationsAsync(vm, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return View(vm);</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    [HasPermission("ReleasePermission", "Create")]</span>
<span>    [HttpPost]</span>
<span>    [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]</span>
<span>    public async Task<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IActionResult<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> Create(ReleasePermissionViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        // 1) محاسبات مجدد</span>
<span>        await PopulateCalculationsAsync(vm, ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) چک یکتایی FeedRecNo</span>
<span>        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(vm.FeedRecNo) <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&amp;">&amp;amp;</span></span>
<span>            await _db.ReleasePermissions.AnyAsync(x =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> x.FeedRecNo == vm.FeedRecNo, ct))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            ModelState.AddModelError(string.Empty,</span>
<span>                $"رکورد تانک {vm.FeedRecNo} قبلاً ثبت شده است");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (!ModelState.IsValid)</span>
<span>            return View(vm);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) ساخت Entity</span>
<span>        var part = vm.CCode == "Y000" ? "melt" : "pst";</span>
<span>        var pType = "Gelatin";</span>
<span>        var permission = vm.CCode == "Y000" ? 8500 : 8500;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var entity = new ReleasePermission</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            FeedRecNo = vm.FeedRecNo!,</span>
<span>            BatchNo = vm.BatchNo!,</span>
<span>            Serial = vm.Serial ?? 0,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            Farsidate = vm.Farsidate,</span>
<span>            Shift = vm.Shift,</span>
<span>            FarsiYear = vm.Farsidate.Substring(0, 4),</span>
<span></span>
<span>            Part = part,</span>
<span>            PType = pType,</span>
<span>            CCode = vm.CCode,</span>
<span>            Machine = vm.Machine,</span>
<span>            Permission = permission,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            TankNo = vm.TankNo,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            Vol0 = vm.Vol0,</span>
<span>            Vis0 = vm.Vis0,</span>
<span>            Vis1 = vm.Vis1,</span>
<span>            LagTime = vm.LagTime,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            C0 = vm.C0 ?? 0,</span>
<span>            C1 = vm.C1 ?? 0,</span>
<span>            Vol1 = vm.Vol1 ?? 0,</span>
<span>            Wei0 = vm.Wei0 ?? 0,</span>
<span>            EqcCapsule = vm.EqcCapsule ?? 0,</span>
<span>            WtrNeed = vm.WtrNeed ?? 0,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            Company = vm.Company,</span>
<span>            ProductName = vm.ProductName,</span>
<span>            ColorCode = vm.ColorCode,</span>
<span>            Notes = vm.Notes,</span>
<span></span>
<span>            CreatedBy = _currentUser.UserId,</span>
<span>            OwnerDepartmentId = null</span>
<span>        };</span>
<span></span>
<span>        _db.ReleasePermissions.Add(entity);</span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 4) ذخیره‌ی مواد</span>
<span>        var materials = await _service.GetFormulaAsync(vm.CCode, ct);</span>
<span>        foreach (var m in materials)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            _db.ReleasePermissionMaterials.Add(new ReleasePermissionMaterial</span>
<span>            {</span>
<span>                ReleasePermissionId = entity.Id,</span>
<span>                MaterialCode = m.MaterialCode,</span>
<span>                RequiredGr = Math.Round(m.Percentage / 100 * entity.EqcCapsule, 4),</span>
<span>                SortOrder = m.SortOrder</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        TempData["Success"] = $"مجوز ساخت {entity.BatchNo} با موفقیت ثبت شد";</span>
<span>        return RedirectToAction(nameof(Details), new { id = entity.Id });</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    // Helper — پر کردن محاسبات</span>
<span>    // ==========================================</span>
<span>    private async Task PopulateCalculationsAsync(ReleasePermissionViewModel vm, CancellationToken ct)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var part = vm.CCode == "Y000" ? "melt" : "pst";</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 1) محاسبات</span>
<span>        var calc = ReleasePermissionCalculator.Calculate(</span>
<span>            part, vm.Vol0, vm.Vis0, vm.Vis1, vm.LagTime);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        vm.C0 = calc.C0;</span>
<span>        vm.C1 = calc.C1;</span>
<span>        vm.Vol1 = calc.Vol1;</span>
<span>        vm.Wei0 = calc.Wei0;</span>
<span>        vm.EqcCapsule = calc.EqcCapsule;</span>
<span>        vm.WtrNeed = calc.WtrNeed;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 2) Serial + FeedRecNo + BatchNo</span>
<span>        var serial = await _service.GetNextSerialAsync(vm.CCode, ct);</span>
<span>        vm.Serial = serial;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var year = vm.Farsidate.Replace("/", "").Substring(0, 4);</span>
<span>        var machineStr = vm.Machine.ToString("D2");</span>
<span>        var partCode = part == "melt" ? "3" : "4";</span>
<span>        var serialStr = serial.ToString("D4");</span>
<span>        vm.FeedRecNo = $"{year}{machineStr}{partCode}{serialStr}";</span>
<span>        vm.BatchNo = $"{(part == "melt" ? "melt" : "pst")}{serial}";</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // 3) فرمول مواد</span>
<span>        var formula = await _service.GetFormulaAsync(vm.CCode, ct);</span>
<span>        vm.FormulaRows = formula.Select(f =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> new FormulaRowViewModel</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            MaterialCode = f.MaterialCode,</span>
<span>            MaterialDisplayName = f.MaterialDisplayName,</span>
<span>            Percentage = f.Percentage,</span>
<span>            RequiredGr = Math.Round(f.Percentage / 100 * vm.EqcCapsule!.Value, 4),</span>
<span>            SortOrder = f.SortOrder</span>
<span>        }).ToList();</span>
<span>    }</span>

<span></span>
<span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>h3<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>i class="bi bi-clipboard-check"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/i<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> مجوزهای ساخت ملت و پیست<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/h3<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>a asp-action="Create" class="btn btn-primary"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>        <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>i class="bi bi-plus-circle"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/i<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> مجوز جدید</span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/a<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/div<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span></span>
<span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>!-- فیلتر --<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>div class="card border-0 shadow-sm mb-3"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>div class="card-body"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>        <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>form asp-action="Index" method="get" class="row g-2"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>            <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>div class="col-md-4"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>input type="text" name="search" value="@ViewBag.Search"</span>
<span>                       class="form-control" placeholder="جستجو (رکورد تانک، شماره بچ، تاریخ)" /<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>            <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/div<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>            <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>div class="col-md-2"<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>

<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/div<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/form<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span></span>
<span>@section Scripts {</span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>partial name="_ValidationScriptsPartial" /<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span></span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>script<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>        $(document).ready(function () {</span>
<span>            $('.calc-input, #cCodeSelect').on('change input', function () {</span>
<span>                recalculate();</span>
<span>            });</span>
<span></span>
<span>            recalculate();</span>
<span></span>
<span>            function recalculate() {</span>
<span>                const data = {</span>
<span>                    part: $('#cCodeSelect').val() === 'Y000' ? 'melt' : 'pst',</span>
<span>                    cCode: $('#cCodeSelect').val(),</span>
<span>                    farsidate: $('#Farsidate').val(),</span>
<span>                    machine: parseInt($('#Machine').val()) || 0,</span>
<span>                    vol0: parseFloat($('#Vol0').val().replace(',', '.')) || 0,</span>
<span>                    vis0: parseFloat($('#Vis0').val().replace(',', '.')) || 0,</span>
<span>                    vis1: parseFloat($('#Vis1').val().replace(',', '.')) || 0,</span>
<span>                    lagTime: parseInt($('#LagTime').val()) || 0</span>
<span>                };</span>
<span></span>
<span>                $.ajax({</span>
<span>                    url: '/api/release-permission/calculate',</span>
<span>                    method: 'POST',</span>
<span>                    contentType: 'application/json',</span>
<span>                    data: JSON.stringify(data),</span>
<span>                    success: function (res) {</span>
<span>                        $('#FeedRecNo').val(res.feedRecNo);</span>
<span>                        $('#BatchNo').val(res.batchNo);</span>
<span>                        $('#Serial').val(res.serial);</span>
<span>                        $('#C0').val(res.c0);</span>
<span>                        $('#C1').val(res.c1);</span>
<span>                        $('#Vol1').val(res.vol1.toFixed(2));</span>
<span>                        $('#Wei0').val(res.wei0.toFixed(2));</span>
<span>                        $('#EqcCapsule').val(res.eqcCapsule.toFixed(2));</span>
<span>                        $('#WtrNeed').val(res.wtrNeed.toFixed(2));</span>
<span></span>
<span>                        const tbody = $('#formulaTable tbody');</span>
<span>                        tbody.empty();</span>
<span>                        res.materials.forEach(function (m) {</span>
<span>                            tbody.append(`</span>
<span>                                <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>tr<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                                    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>td<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>${m.materialDisplayName}<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/td<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                                    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>td<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>strong<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>${m.requiredGr.toFixed(4)}<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/strong<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span><span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/td<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                                <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/tr<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>                            `);</span>
<span>                        });</span>
<span>                    },</span>
<span>                    error: function (xhr) {</span>
<span>                        console.error('خطا در محاسبه:', xhr);</span>
<span>                    }</span>
<span>                });</span>
<span>            }</span>
<span>        });</span>
<span>    <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/script<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using System.Globalization;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ModelBinding;</span>
<span></span>
<span>namespace GelatinCapsule.Web.Infrastructure;</span>
<span></span>
<span>/// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>/// ModelBinder سفارشی برای decimal که هم نقطه و هم ویرگول رو قبول می‌کنه</span>
<span>/// و پیام خطای فارسی می‌ده</span>
<span>/// <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>/summary<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>public class DecimalModelBinder : IModelBinder</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public Task BindModelAsync(ModelBindingContext bindingContext)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var valueProviderResult = bindingContext.ValueProvider.GetValue(bindingContext.ModelName);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (valueProviderResult == ValueProviderResult.None)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        bindingContext.ModelState.SetModelValue(bindingContext.ModelName, valueProviderResult);</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var value = valueProviderResult.FirstValue;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        value = value.Trim();</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // تبدیل ویرگول فارسی (٫) و ویرگول معمولی (,) به نقطه</span>
<span>        value = value.Replace("٫", ".").Replace(",", ".");</span>
<span></span>
<span>        // اگه چند تا نقطه داشت، همه رو حذف کن به جز آخری</span>
<span>        var dotCount = value.Count(c =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> c == '.');</span>
<span>        if (dotCount <span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span> 1)</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var lastDotIndex = value.LastIndexOf('.');</span>
<span>            var before = value.Substring(0, lastDotIndex).Replace(".", "");</span>
<span>            var after = value.Substring(lastDotIndex);</span>
<span>            value = before + after;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (decimal.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Number, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            bindingContext.Result = ModelBindingResult.Success(result);</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        else</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            var label = GetFieldLabel(bindingContext);</span>
<span>            bindingContext.ModelState.TryAddModelError(</span>
<span>                bindingContext.ModelName,</span>
<span>                $"لطفاً برای «{label}» یک عدد معتبر وارد کنید");</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return Task.CompletedTask;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span></span>
<span>    private string GetFieldLabel(ModelBindingContext context)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        var metadata = context.ModelMetadata;</span>
<span>        return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(metadata.DisplayName)</span>
<span>            ? metadata.DisplayName</span>
<span>            : metadata.Name;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>public class DecimalModelBinderProvider : IModelBinderProvider</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    public IModelBinder? GetBinder(ModelBinderProviderContext context)</span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));</span>
<span></span>
<span>        var modelType = context.Metadata.ModelType;</span>
<span></span>
<span>        if (modelType == typeof(decimal) || modelType == typeof(decimal?))</span>
<span>        {</span>
<span>            return new DecimalModelBinder();</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span></span>
<span>        return null;</span>
<span>    }</span>
<span>}<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span></span>

<span></span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>span</span> <span class="token attr-name">class</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>lang-label<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>C# - Program.cs<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>span</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>  <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>div</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>pre</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>code</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>using System.Globalization;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Application.Common.Interfaces;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence;</span>
<span>using GelatinCapsule.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seed;</span>

<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;</span>
<span>using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;</span>

<span></span>
<span>var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Culture ============</span>
<span>// از InvariantCulture استفاده می‌کنیم که اعشارش نقطه‌ست</span>
<span>// کاربر می‌تونه هم نقطه و هم ویرگول وارد کنه (با ModelBinder سفارشی)</span>
<span>var invariantCulture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;</span>
<span>CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = invariantCulture;</span>
<span>CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = invariantCulture;</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Connection String ============</span>
<span>var connectionString = builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")</span>
<span>    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Connection string 'DefaultConnection' not found.");</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ DbContext ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ApplicationDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>(options =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    options.UseSqlServer(connectionString, sql =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        sql.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(ApplicationDbContext).Assembly.FullName);</span>
<span>        sql.EnableRetryOnFailure(3);</span>
<span>    }));</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Cache ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Application Services ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>PasswordHasher<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthService, AuthService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IPermissionService, PermissionService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ICurrentUserService, CurrentUserService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IDataScopeService, DataScopeService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IReleasePermissionService, ReleasePermissionService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Cookie Authentication ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)</span>
<span>    .AddCookie(options =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>    {</span>
<span>        options.LoginPath = "/Account/Login";</span>
<span>        options.LogoutPath = "/Account/Logout";</span>
<span>        options.AccessDeniedPath = "/Account/AccessDenied";</span>
<span>        options.ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(8);</span>
<span>        options.SlidingExpiration = true;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.Name = "GelatinCapsule.Auth";</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.SecurePolicy = CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest;</span>
<span>        options.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;</span>
<span>    });</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Authorization ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddSingleton<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthorizationPolicyProvider, PermissionPolicyProvider<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddScoped<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>IAuthorizationHandler, PermissionAuthorizationHandler<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ MVC + Custom Decimal ModelBinder ============</span>
<span>builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews(options =<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span></span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    // DecimalModelBinder رو در ابتدای لیست می‌ذاریم که اولین binder باشه</span>
<span>    options.ModelBinderProviders.Insert(0, new DecimalModelBinderProvider());</span>
<span>});</span>
<span></span>
<span>var app = builder.Build();</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Seed Database ============</span>
<span>using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())</span>
<span>{</span>
<span>    var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&lt;">&amp;lt;</span>ApplicationDbContext<span class="token entity named-entity" title="&gt;">&amp;gt;</span>();</span>
<span>    await db.Database.MigrateAsync();</span>
<span>    await ApplicationDbSeeder.SeedAsync(db);</span>
<span>}</span>
<span></span>
<span>// ============ Pipeline ============</span>
<span>if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())</span>
<span>{</span>

### User

---

### User

نه تمام اینایی که گفتی به درد خودت میخوره از اول با ادرس بگو چیو باید کچا اضاضفه کنم یا چیو کجا باید جدید بسازم

---

### DeepSeek AI

<span><span class="token doctype"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;!</span><span class="token doctype-tag">DOCTYPE</span> <span class="token name">html</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>style</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>        @@page { size: A4; margin: 15mm; }</span>
<span>        * { box-sizing: border-box; }</span>
<span>        body {</span>
<span>            font-family: Tahoma, sans-serif;</span>
<span>            font-size: 13px;</span>
<span>            margin: 0;</span>
<span>            padding: 20px;</span>
<span>            direction: rtl;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 20px; }</span>
<span>        .logo img { width: 80px; }</span>
<span>        .title { text-align: center; flex: 1; }</span>
<span>        .title h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; }</span>
<span>        .title h2 { margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: normal; }</span>
<span>        .license-number { text-align: left; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 10px; }</span>
<span>        table td, table th { border: 1px solid #333; padding: 6px 8px; }</span>
<span>        .info-table td { font-size: 13px; }</span>
<span>        .info-table .label { background: #f0f0f0; font-weight: bold; width: 120px; }</span>
<span>        .materials-table { margin-top: 15px; }</span>
<span>        .materials-table th { background: #f0f0f0; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        .gelatin-section { margin-top: 15px; }</span>
<span>        .gelatin-section table { width: 70%; }</span>
<span>        .signatures { margin-top: 40px; display: flex; gap: 10px; }</span>
<span>        .signatures div { flex: 1; border: 1px solid #333; padding: 25px 10px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        .no-print { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }</span>
<span>        .no-print button { padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; }</span>
<span>        @@media print {</span>
<span>            .no-print { display: none; }</span>
<span>            body { padding: 0; }</span>
<span>        }</span>

<span><span class="token doctype"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;!</span><span class="token doctype-tag">DOCTYPE</span> <span class="token name">html</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

<span><span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>head</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>meta</span> <span class="token attr-name">charset</span><span class="token attr-value"><span class="token punctuation attr-equals">=</span><span class="token punctuation">"</span>utf-8<span class="token punctuation">"</span></span> <span class="token punctuation">/&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>title</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span>مجوز ساخت پیست - @Model.BatchNo<span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>title</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;</span>style</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>
<span>        @@page { size: A4; margin: 15mm; }</span>
<span>        * { box-sizing: border-box; }</span>
<span>        body {</span>
<span>            font-family: Tahoma, sans-serif;</span>
<span>            font-size: 13px;</span>
<span>            margin: 0;</span>
<span>            padding: 20px;</span>
<span>            direction: rtl;</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>        .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 20px; }</span>
<span>        .logo img { width: 80px; }</span>
<span>        .title { text-align: center; flex: 1; }</span>
<span>        .title h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; }</span>
<span>        .title h2 { margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: normal; }</span>
<span>        .license-number { text-align: left; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 10px; }</span>
<span>        table td, table th { border: 1px solid #333; padding: 6px 8px; }</span>
<span>        .info-table td { font-size: 13px; }</span>
<span>        .info-table .label { background: #f0f0f0; font-weight: bold; width: 150px; }</span>
<span>        .materials-table { margin-top: 15px; }</span>
<span>        .materials-table th { background: #f0f0f0; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        .signatures { margin-top: 40px; display: flex; gap: 10px; }</span>
<span>        .signatures div { flex: 1; border: 1px solid #333; padding: 25px 10px; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; }</span>
<span>        .no-print { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; }</span>
<span>        .no-print button { padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; }</span>
<span>        @@media print {</span>
<span>            .no-print { display: none; }</span>
<span>            body { padding: 0; }</span>
<span>        }</span>
<span>    <span class="token tag"><span class="token tag"><span class="token punctuation">&lt;/</span>style</span><span class="token punctuation">&gt;</span></span></span>

fill="currentColor"></path></svg></div><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><strong><span class="">این Warning نیست، فقط یه هشداره که از قبل داشتیم.</span></strong><span class=""> چون ما </span>`HasQueryFilter`<span class=""> روی </span>`Role`<span class=""> گذاشتیم (برای Soft Delete) و </span>`UserRole`<span class=""> به </span>`Role`<span class=""> وابسته‌ست، EF هشدار میده که شاید رکوردهای </span>`UserRole`<span class=""> وقتی </span>`Role`<span class=""> حذف شده، پنهان بشن.</span></p><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><strong><span class="">این مشکلی برای ما نداره</span></strong><span class=""> چون:</span></p><ul><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">`UserRole`<span class=""> فقط یه جدول واسطه‌ست</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">وقتی </span>`Role`<span class=""> Soft-Delete میشه، </span>`UserRole`<span class=""> واقعاً حذف نمیشه (فقط از دید Query پنهان میشه)</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">توی آینده اگه لازم شد می‌تونیم </span>`IgnoreQueryFilters`<span class=""> کنیم</span></p></li></ul><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><strong><span class="">پس این Warning رو نادیده بگیر.</span></strong></p><hr><h2><span class="">🛑 الان این کارها رو بکن:</span></h2><ol start="1"><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">✅ </span>`ReleasePermissionGelatinConfiguration.cs`<span class=""> رو درست کن (</span>`.WithMany(x =&gt; x.Gelatins)`<span class="">)</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">✅ </span>`Remove-Migration`<span class=""> بزن</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">✅ </span><strong><span class="">Ctrl + Shift + B</span></strong></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">✅ </span>`Add-Migration Add_LicenseSerial_And_Gelatin_Table`<span class=""> بزن</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">✅ </span>`Update-Database`<span class=""> بزن</span></p></li></ol><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><strong><span class="">نتیجه رو بفرست:</span></strong></p><ul><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">اگه Migration موفق شد → ادامه میدیم به تست</span></p></li><li><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span class="">اگه خطا داد → متن خطا</span></p></li></ul><p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><strong><span class="">منتظرم.</span></strong><span class=""> ⏳</span></p>
